gloss: already; no longer; now; by this point

definitions.explanation: Used with negative expressions to indicate that something is no longer the case. Implies a change from a previous state.

definitions.gloss: already; by now; at this point
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a situation has reached a certain point. Often used to emphasize that something has become inevitable or has progressed beyond a certain stage.

examples.english: She is no longer a child.

notes:
USAGE:
{最早|もはや} marks a line already crossed. With a negative it says something is no longer so; with a plain statement it says the situation has already reached a point there is no arguing with. Either way it looks back at a change that has finished, which is what separates it from ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧ — the everyday word that covers the same ground without the note of finality.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {最早|もはや}〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no longer ~
- {最早|もはや}⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戻|もど}らない→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: will never go back to how it was
- {最早|もはや}これまで⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: this is the end of it
- {最早|もはや}⟦{疑|うたが}う→疑う：01889_utagau⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no longer room for doubt

WRITING NOTE:
Usually written in kana as もはや. The kanji spelling {最早|もはや} is a jukujikun — the reading does not follow from the individual characters — and belongs to formal or literary writing.

REGISTER:
Formal and somewhat literary. In speech ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧ does the same work: {最早|もはや}〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (written) = ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (spoken). {最早|もはや} also turns up in commentary and headlines for rhetorical weight, as in ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最早|もはや}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧.

SIMILAR ADVERBS:
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧: already, no longer — neutral and far more common in speech
- ⟦{今更|いまさら}→今更：01743_imasara⟧: too late now — stresses that acting at this point is pointless, where {最早|もはや} simply reports the state
